report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Hipótesis diagnóstica: lesion meniscal externa.
Hallazgos:
Médula ósea de intensidad de señal normal. Pequeño ganglión intraóseo adyacente a la inserción distal del
LCA.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales sin alteraciones.
Cartílago femorotibial con alteración de señal, superficie irregular y defectos espesor subtotal a nivel de la
superficie de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Cartílago de la patela con alteración de señal y defectos de espesor parcial y subtotal, este último a nivel de
la faceta medial donde se acompaña de edema óseo.
Cartílago de la tróclea con alteración de señal, defectos de espesor subtotal y significativa pérdida a nivel de
la vertiente lateral, con edema óseo subyacente.
Rotura degenerativa que compromete cuerno anterior, cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco lateral con un
componente desplazado hacia el receso menisco femoral nivel del cuerpo.
Rotura degenerativa longitudinal horizontal que compromete cuerno posterior del menisco medial con
segmento parcialmente desplazado receso menisco tibial.
Tendón del cuádriceps, rotuliano, de la pata de ganso, bicipital y banda iliotibial de grosor e intensidad de
señal normales.
Edema cóndilo externo adyacente la de la tibia.
Leve derrame articular con signos de sinovitis. No se observa quiste de Baker.
Impresión:
Rotura degenerativa del menisco lateral con componente desplazado hacia el receso menisco femoral.
Rotura degenerativa horizontal del cuerno posterior y región corporal del menisco medial, con pequeño
segmento desplazado.
Condropatía femorotibial grado 3.
Condropatía grado 4 de la patela y la tróclea.
Derrame articular con signos de sinovitis

Findings:  There is a mild knee effusion. There is complex tearing of the posterior horn and root of the medial meniscus with partial extrusion of the medial meniscal body from the joint. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Moderate - severe thinning and loss of the medial compartment articular cartilage is noted. The lateral compartment articular cartilage is preserved. Mild degeneration of the patellar ridge articular cartilage is noted.  
Conclusion: Complex tearing of the posterior horn and root of the medial meniscus.

MRI of knee in sagittal section (Proton density with fat saturation, T1WI, T2WI with fat saturation), axial section (T2WI with fat saturation) and coronal section (T2WI with fat saturation):

* Small osteochondral defect at posterior portion of lateral femoral condyle is suspected, r/o osteochondral lesion.

> The contour of anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.

Impressions: 
1. R/O small osteochondral lesion at posterior portion of lateral femoral condyle
2. No evidence of mensicus tear
3. Normal appearance of ligaments of knee joint

Suggest clinical correlation

Trouvailles : 

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec un petit kyste poplité non-rupturé.

Il y a un minime amincissement et une fibrillation superficielle du cartilage du compartiment interne et patellofémoral. Il n'y a pas de région de perte de cartilage complète. Le cartilage du compartiment externe est sans particularité. Il y a des changements dégénératifs intrasubstances impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure longitudinale d’orientation horizontale s’étendant de la corne postérieure jusqu’au niveau du corps. Il y a un fragment déplacé en provenance du corps au niveau de la gouttière tibiale médiale (composante de type flap). Le ménisque externe est sans particularité. 

Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et le tendon du poplité, le biceps femoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette iliotibiale sont sans particularité. 

Conclusion :

Légers changements dégénératifs des compartiments internes et patellofémoral, sans région de perte de cartilage complète. 

Changements dégénératifs intrasubstances du ménisque interne avec une déchirure horizontale et un fragment déplacé tels que ci-haut. 

Petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec petit kyste poplité non-rupturé.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [PROFESSION]. Diffuse right knee pain after knee to knee collision(s). 
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
There is a moderate, diffuse bone contusion involving the most anterior aspect of the medial femoral condyle and a mild, small contusion at the most anterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle. There is a moderate focal bone contusion at the lateral aspect of the patella. No acute fracture on MRI. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
There is a moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is mild blunting/fraying of the inner margin of the medial meniscus without tear.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: There is partial thickness, in part delaminating cartilage fissuring (grade 3 chondral fissuring) at the central weightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condyle (se 8, img 8 to 12). Very small marginal osteophytes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is a chronic, 15 x 15 mm full-thickness cartilage defect (grade 4 chondral defect) at the groove of the femoral trochlea extending into the lateral aspect of the trochlea with subchondral cystic change. There is partial thickness cartilage fissuring (grade 2 chondral fissuring) at the medial and lateral patellar facets. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal. There is a mild contusion/sprain of the joint capsule of the proximal tibiofibular joint.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: There is bony fragmentation of the tibial tubercle consistent with Osgood Schlatter Mild tendinosis and fraying and of the proximal and distal patellar tendon without tear . 
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 18 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:. 
1. Moderate, diffuse bone contusion involving the most anterior aspect of the medial femoral condyle and a mild, small contusion at the most anterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle. Additional moderate focal bone contusion at the lateral aspect of the patella.
2. Moderate joint effusion. 
3. Moderate chronic patellofemoral chondrosis and mild lateral compartment chondrosis. 
4. Mild contusion/sprain of the joint capsule of the proximal tibiofibular joint.
5. Osgood Schlatter with chronic tendinosis and fraying of both the proximal and distal patellar tendon without tendon tear. 
6. No meniscal or ligament tears.

Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis with interstitial fluid, correlate for tendinitis. Isolated quadriceps fat pad edema, may suggest impingement syndrome.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Lateral patellar tilt. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

1.	Near-circumferential lateral meniscus tear with tiny parameniscal cysts.
2.	Quadriceps fat pad edema with mild distal quadriceps tendinosis/tendinitis, correlate for impingement syndrome.
3.	No significant chondrosis.
